author: Make Something
description:
Trying to make custom handmade wooden coasters. Brought to us by Squarespace. For 10% off your first purchase, go to: http://squarespace.com/makesomething

Hardwood from Kencraft: https://goo.gl/pCyB95

Patreon members get Fusion 360 files, early and ad-free videos, my custom finish, behind the scenes videos, as well as access to our private Discord: https://www.patreon.com/picciuto

I wanted to hide a lake inside a set of coasters. Two squares that look like nothing until you slide them together and reveal a bathymetric depth map carved in wood and filled with resin. Six layers of shop-made maple plywood, scroll saw cuts, and an epoxy pour. What could go wrong? Turns out, a lot. This is also a prototype for a much larger wall art piece, so every hard lesson here was worth it.
